---
title: "captions"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("caption.R"); clag_install()
mode <- Sys.getenv("CAP_MODE", "after")
if (mode == "after") clag_install_captions() else if (mode == "early") clag_install_captions_early() else if (mode == "chunk") clag_install_captions_chunkhook()
n_sites <- 5; depth <- 0.62; slope <- 0.3; tier <- "sev"
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-a
#| fig-cap: 'A. Depth at [a site | # sites]{n="n_sites"}, mean `r depth`{.dec1 claim=". > 0.5"} m, [rose | fell]{if="slope > 0"}.'
#| fig-alt: 'ALT A. Depth at [a site | # sites]{n="n_sites"}, mean `r depth`{.dec1} m.'
n_sites <- 7
plot(1:3)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-b
#| fig-cap: !expr 'clag_str(r"(B. Depth at [a site | # sites]{n="n_sites"}, mean `r depth`{.dec1} m.)")'
#| fig-alt: !expr 'clag_str(r"(ALT B. [a site | # sites]{n="n_sites"})")'
n_sites <- 8
plot(1:3)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-d
#| fig-cap: 'D. Panels at [a site | # sites]{n="n_sites"}'
#| fig-subcap:
#|   - 'D1. first: [a site | # sites]{n="n_sites"}'
#|   - 'D2. second: mean `r depth`{.dec1} m'
#| layout-ncol: 2
n_sites <- 11
plot(1:3); plot(3:1)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-a
#| tbl-cap: 'TA. kable at [a site | # sites]{n="n_sites"}, mean `r depth`{.dec1} m.'
n_sites <- 12
knitr::kable(data.frame(x = 1:2, y = 3:4))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-b
#| tbl-cap: 'TB. gt at [a site | # sites]{n="n_sites"}.'
n_sites <- 13
gt::gt(data.frame(x = 1:2, y = 3:4))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-c
#| tbl-cap: !expr 'clag_str(r"(TC. expr at [a site | # sites]{n="n_sites"})")'
n_sites <- 14
knitr::kable(data.frame(x = 1:2, y = 3:4))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-d
n_sites <- 15
knitr::kable(data.frame(x = 1:2, y = 3:4), caption = clag_str(r"(TD. kable(caption=) at [a site | # sites]{n="n_sites"})"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-e
n_sites <- 16
gt::gt(data.frame(x = 1:2, y = 3:4)) |> gt::tab_caption(clag_str(r"(TE. gt tab_caption at [a site | # sites]{n="n_sites"})"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-f
#| tbl-cap: "TF. kable with BOTH tbl-cap and caption"
n_sites <- 17
knitr::kable(data.frame(x = 1:2, y = 3:4), caption = clag_str(r"(TF-inner [a site | # sites]{n="n_sites"})"))
```

```{r}
#| label: gg
n_sites <- 18
p <- ggplot(data.frame(x=1:3,y=1:3), aes(x,y)) + geom_point() + labs(caption = clag_str(r"(GG. [a site | # sites]{n="n_sites"})"))
cat("GGCAPTION:", p$labels$caption, "\n")
```
